comments.body:
Cross-source audit finding (2026-07-30): this is NOT confined to the weekly canary — the same failure is hitting the on-demand `Live External Integration` workflow, and it failed **every** run dispatched today.

All 6 `Live External Integration` runs on 2026-07-30 failed (UTC):
  02:10:36 (30507727332), 02:37:12 (30508956696), 03:59:13 (30512622682),
  05:05:12 (30515632763), 18:59:36 (30572868192), 19:46:17 (30576261975)
Over the 7-day window I inventoried (2026-07-23 -> 07-30, 2,598 Actions runs) there were 7 failures of this workflow and no successes.

Verbatim from run 30576261975, job "external integration (live services)":

    rebar._snapshot.repo_snapshot.SnapshotRefError: cannot resolve ref 'HEAD' to a commit in
    '/home/runner/work/_temp/rebar-basetemp/test_live_plan_review_workflow0/repo'. Name a valid
    branch, tag, or full SHA reachable from 'origin'. Fetching an arbitrary SHA also requires the
    remote's uploadpack.allowReachableSHA1InWant (or fetch a containing ref then resolve).
      src/rebar/_snapshot/repo_snapshot.py:377: SnapshotRefError

    7 failed, 21 passed, 1 skipped, 1 xfailed, 1 warning in 101.45s (0:01:41)

The 7 failing tests are consistent across runs:
  tests/external/test_execution_mode_live.py::test_single_turn_live_structured_output
  tests/external/test_pydantic_ai_cutover_live.py::test_pydantic_review_ticket_opus
  tests/external/test_pydantic_ai_cutover_live.py::test_pydantic_review_code
  tests/external/test_pydantic_ai_cutover_live.py::test_pydantic_scan_spec
  tests/external/test_pydantic_ai_cutover_live.py::test_pydantic_verify_completion
  tests/external/test_workflow_live.py::test_live_review_skeleton_workflow_end_to_end
  tests/external/test_workflow_live.py::test_live_plan_review_workflow_engine_produces_real_verdict

Two other jobs in the same runs also fail — "langfuse tracing round-trip (ephemeral self-hosted)" in every case, and "jira DC harness smoke" in run 30572868192. I did not determine whether those share this root cause or are independent; worth checking before scoping the fix, since a fix targeting only the snapshot path may leave the workflow red.

Scope note for the ticket title: "weekly canary red since 2026-07-14" understates it — the failure reproduces on every dispatch, so it is continuous, not weekly.

compiled_state.description:
## Symptom

The weekly `external-integration.yml` canary has been RED continuously for at least ten days. Both of its
jobs — `external integration (live services)` and `langfuse tracing round-trip` — fail with the same error,
repeated once per live test:

    rebar._snapshot.repo_snapshot.SnapshotRefError: cannot resolve ref 'HEAD' to a commit in
    '/home/runner/work/_temp/rebar-basetemp/<test-name>0/repo'. Name a valid branch, tag, or full SHA
    reachable from 'origin'. Fetching an arbitrary SHA also requires the remote's
    uploadpack.allowReachableSHA1InWant (or fetch a containing ref then resolve).

Confirmed tests (non-exhaustive — 7 distinct in one run, 35 error occurrences in another):

- `tests/external/test_execution_mode_live.py::test_single_turn_live_structured_output`
- `tests/external/test_pydantic_ai_cutover_live.py::test_pydantic_review_ticket_opus`
- `tests/external/test_pydantic_ai_cutover_live.py::test_pydantic_review_code`
- `tests/external/test_pydantic_ai_cutover_live.py::test_pydantic_scan_spec`
- `tests/external/test_pydantic_ai_cutover_live.py::test_pydantic_verify_completion`
- `tests/external/…::test_live_review_skeleton_work…`
- `tests/external/…::test_live_plan_review_workflow…`

## Run history — this is ONE continuous defect, not a flake

| run | date | trigger | result |
|---|---|---|---|
| 29072551997 | 2026-07-10 | dispatch | success |
| 29231252567 | 2026-07-13 | schedule | failure |
| 29306638680 | 2026-07-14 | dispatch | **success (last known green)** |
| 29723705918 | 2026-07-20 | schedule | failure |
| 30245319041 | 2026-07-27 | schedule | failure (**35** `SnapshotRefError` occurrences) |
| 30507727332 / 30508956696 / 30512622682 / 30515632763 | 2026-07-30 | dispatch | failure (same two jobs) |

The 2026-07-27 cron and the 2026-07-30 runs fail with the identical error in the identical tests, so this is a
single persistent defect rather than intermittent flake. Last known green is **2026-07-14**.

## Why it went unnoticed — the guard that should have caught this is adjacent to the broken thing

`tests/external/conftest.py`'s all-skip canary (story `5f39`, "Scheduled external contract canary that fails
when all live tests skip") exists to stop a scheduled run going green while validating nothing. It works: the
2026-07-30 run logged `[jira-live-canary] collected=9 executed=8 skipped=1`. But the canary only guards
against *silent skipping*; here the tests are **failing loudly** and the job is correctly red — nobody was
watching the weekly result. A red canary that no one reads is the same blind spot the canary was built to
close, one level up.

## Scope note — what this is NOT

This is **not** caused by the `jira DC harness smoke` job added by story `c97f`. That job was introduced on
2026-07-30 and **passes**; the two failing jobs failed identically on the 2026-07-20 and 2026-07-27 crons,
before it existed. Job-level comparison:

- 2026-07-27 (pre-existing): `langfuse tracing round-trip` FAIL, `external integration` FAIL
- 2026-07-30 (current):      `langfuse tracing round-trip` FAIL, `external integration` FAIL, `jira DC harness smoke` **SUCCESS**

Per-commit CI (`build-and-test`) on `main` is green; this is confined to the weekly external tier.

## Leads (not conclusions — this ticket is filed from CI evidence, not a debugging pass)

- The message names `origin` and `uploadpack.allowReachableSHA1InWant`, and the failing path is a scratch repo
  created under pytest's `basetemp`. The likely shape is a fixture building a throwaway repo that has no
  commit on `HEAD` and/or no reachable `origin`, then handing it to `repo_snapshot`.
- `git log` shows **no commits to `src/rebar/_snapshot/repo_snapshot.py`** in the 2026-07-13 → 2026-07-21
  window, so the change is more likely test/fixture-side, or a behavioural change in a caller, than in the
  snapshot helper itself.
- Three CLOSED bugs sit in this same family and are worth reading before investigating — this may be a
  regression of one: `0de0` ("remove stale test_ref_lock_ac0_live: assumes a writable origin remote"),
  `4e73` ("external-integration 'external' job fails: session test guard leaves ALL…"), `416d`
  ("langfuse-trace job tests removed behavior + readiness probe imports…").
- A `git bisect` over 2026-07-14 → 2026-07-20 against one of the named tests should localise it quickly,
  since there is a known good→bad transition.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] the root cause of the `SnapshotRefError` is identified and cited (`path:line`), and stated as a
      changeable artifact rather than a category
- [ ] a test reproduces the failure WITHOUT requiring live credentials or a billable LLM call, so the
      regression is guarded in the default suite rather than only in the weekly external tier
- [ ] `external-integration.yml` runs green on a `workflow_dispatch`, with the `external` and
      `langfuse tracing round-trip` jobs both passing (or, where a job genuinely requires a secret this repo
      does not hold, it SKIPS explicitly with a stated reason rather than failing)
- [ ] the all-skip canary still fires if that skip path is ever taken for every live test — the fix must not
      turn a red canary into a vacuously green one
- [ ] the weekly result becomes visible to someone: a notification, a required check, or a documented owner,
      so a ten-day-red canary cannot recur unnoticed

file_impact.reason: four of the confirmed failing live tests
the scratch-repo fixture path that hands HEAD to repo_snapshot; also hosts the all-skip canary that must keep firing
raises SnapshotRefError; unchanged in the good->bad window so likely the reporter, not the cause
the weekly canary whose red result went unread for ten days
